feature_name: Storage Transfer Service filesystem transfer jobs with periodic sync
summary: Adds preview support for API- and gcloud-managed transfer jobs that move and sync data between two filesystems on a scheduled basis, including migration from on-premises filesystems to Filestore.
extended_definition: Adds preview support for API- and gcloud-managed transfer jobs that move and sync data between two filesystems on a scheduled basis, including migration from on-premises filesystems to Filestore.
